entries.quote: The two terms of the ratio.

entries.claim: We have learned in previous phases the subject of ratio, and that ratio is a comparison between two quantities.
entries.quote: We have learned in the previous phases the subject of ratio

entries.claim: The ratio between two numbers a and b can be written as a to b, or a:b, or a/b.
entries.quote: the ratio between the two numbers a and b can be written as a to b or a:b or

entries.claim: In the ratio a:b, a is called the antecedent and b the consequent; a and b together are the two terms of the ratio.
entries.quote: a will be called an antecedant and b is consequent
